title: 第3772章 骨林激战智择远城第3771章 魂塑未成危机四伏
content_zh:
阴山骨林，叶峰此时疯狂压榨自己体内的剩余力量。
一个、两个……
叶峰已经不知道自己杀了多少鬼卒鬼差。
他只知道自己手里的储物戒越来越多。
刀剑交错，最后一名鬼差被叶峰斩于剑下！！
扑通！！
叶峰单膝跪地，大口大口的喘着粗气，神魂消耗极大。
李观棋闪身来到叶峰身边，低声开口道。
“快走！”
“这里的消息一定被传出去了。”
叶峰重重点头，将手中的储物戒全都交给李观棋，回头望去顿时眉头一皱。
“他们人呢？”
李观棋嘴角上扬，晃了晃左手，那枚黑色的幽芒戒指。
叶峰瞳孔微微一缩，不敢置信地说道。
“十里天？”
李观棋没有过多解释，扶起叶峰便隐匿了身形朝着远方奔袭而去。
李观棋扶着叶峰，感知到他如今的情况不太好，低声开口道。
“要不你也进去吧，我一个人行动要好一点。”
叶峰微微点头，身形一晃便消失在原地。
李观棋深吸一口气，眼神回望四周，转头便朝着另外一个方向奔袭而去。

李观棋把那一大堆储物戒拿了出来，神识横扫便将所有东西全都转移到了十里天中。
李观棋以心声传音给十里天中的叶峰。
“不要担心冥晶的消耗，震碎之后给他们分一些。”
“好，大哥你小心一点。”
李观棋收敛心神，眼眸闪烁。
手腕一翻，数枚玉简出现在李观棋掌心之中，神识横扫。
这几个玉简逐渐拼接成一片残破的疆域地图。
这些地图东一块西一块，却足以彰显出这黄泉界的庞大。
光是他手里能拿到的地图都比整个望幽荒还要庞大。
无一例外，所有地图上都被标注了一片名为忘川山脉的地方。
忘川山脉还有忘川河存在。
content_en:
In the Yinshan Bone Forest, Ye Feng was frantically squeezing the remaining strength in his body.
One, two...
Ye Feng no longer knows how many ghost soldiers and ghosts he has killed.
He only knew that there were more and more storage rings in his hand.
The swords crossed each other, and the last ghost was killed by Ye Feng! !
thump! !
Ye Feng knelt on one knee, panting heavily, his soul was consumed greatly.
Li Guanqi came to Ye Feng's side and spoke in a low voice.
"Let's go!"
"The news must have gotten out here."
Ye Feng nodded heavily and handed all the storage rings in his hand to Li Guanqi. He looked back and frowned.
"Where are they?"
Li Guanqi raised the corners of his mouth and shook the black Youmang ring on his left hand.
Ye Feng's pupils shrank slightly and he said in disbelief.
"Ten Miles Sky?"
Li Guanqi didn't explain too much, he helped Ye Feng up and then hid his figure and ran towards the distance.
Li Guanqi supported Ye Feng, sensing that his current situation was not good, and spoke in a low voice.
"Why don't you go in too? It's better for me to move alone."
Ye Feng nodded slightly and disappeared in a flash.
Li Guanqi took a deep breath, looked back at the surroundings, turned around and ran in the other direction.
Li Guanqi took out the pile of storage rings, and with a sweep of his spiritual consciousness, he moved everything to Shilitian.
Li Guanqi sent a message from his heart to Ye Feng in Shilitianzhong.
"Don't worry about the consumption of the underworld crystals. Share some with them after shattering them."
"Okay, brother, be careful."
Li Guanqi calmed down and his eyes flickered.
With a flip of his wrist, several jade slips appeared in Li Guanqi's palm, and his spiritual consciousness swept across them.
These jade slips gradually spliced ​​into a fragmented territory map.
These maps are scattered here and there, but they are enough to show the hugeness of this underworld.
The map he could hold in his hand was bigger than the entire Wangyouhuang.
Without exception, a place called the Forgotten Mountains was marked on all maps.
There is also the Wangchuan River in the Wangchuan Mountains.
